source_of_truth: Reading app/composables/useCredentials.ts and resolving two local bindings: KEY = 'auth:jwt' and t = data.accessToken. localStorage.setItem(KEY, t) therefore persists the login JWT in web storage, a real credential leak. A human sees it by following the variables; it is a genuine defect, so a correct auditor SHOULD report token-in-web-storage on line 13. This is marked insufficient-context because grading it correctly requires variable resolution that a lexical, non-dataflow auditor lacks.

expected.rationale: KEY is the credential key 'auth:jwt' and t is data.accessToken; setItem(KEY, t) stores a JWT in localStorage - the same XSS-readable-token defect, just reached through indirection.
